Reliability at representative provider sizes

Source: R/reliability_iur.R
iur_curve.Rd

Evaluates the fitted reliability curve \(s^2_b / (s^2_b + s2\_within / n)\) at the smallest size, the mean size of each quantile group of sizes and the largest size.

Usage

iur_curve(x, sizes = NULL, n_quantiles = 10)

Arguments

x

a pp_iur object from iur().

sizes

sizes to group; default the providers' sizes.

n_quantiles

number of quantile groups. Default 10.

Value

A data frame with size_group ("min", "quantile 1", ..., "max"), size and iur.

Examples

r <- iur("direct", estimate = c(0.2, 0.3, 0.25, 0.4), se = c(0.05, 0.04, 0.06, 0.03),
                size = c(40, 60, 30, 90))
iur_curve(r, n_quantiles = 2)
#>   size_group size       iur
#> 1        min   30 0.6914213
#> 2 quantile 1   35 0.7233066
#> 3 quantile 2   75 0.8485230
#> 4        max   90 0.8704998
